description: This Java source file defines the ProductsController class, which handles HTTP requests related to product management in the admin web interface. It includes methods for displaying product listings, paging through products, and deleting products, with relevant external dependencies on services and models.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Controller class for admin product management, providing endpoints for viewing, paginating, and deleting products.

methods.name: displayProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product management page, sets up categories and menu.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST requests to return a paginated list of products based on filters.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific product by ID.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the administrative interface.
